    <h2>{`About this task`}</h2>
    <p>{`In Graphite applications, there are often scenarios where you need to persist user preferences, form inputs, or application state even when the application is closed and reopened. This guide explains different methods for implementing persistent storage in your Graphite application to enhance user experience by remembering important values across sessions.`}</p>

      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`sessionStorage`}</strong>{` - Similar to localStorage but cleared when the browser session ends`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Application state`}</strong>{` - For persisting data within the current application session`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Server-side storage`}</strong>{` - For persisting data across devices and users`}</li>
    </ol>

    <h3>{`Step 3: Implement persistence using localStorage`}</h3>
    <p>{`The most common method for client-side persistence is using localStorage:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// Save a value to localStorage
function saveValue(key, value) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to save data to localStorage', error);
  }
}

// Retrieve a value from localStorage
function getValue(key, defaultValue) {
  try {
    const storedValue = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return storedValue ? JSON.parse(storedValue) : defaultValue;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to retrieve data from localStorage', error);
    return defaultValue;
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 4: Integrate with page initialization`}</h3>
    <p>{`Add code to retrieve and apply saved values when your page initializes:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Initialize page with persisted values
 * @param {Object} page - The page object
 * @param {Object} app - The application object
 */
async pageInitialized(page, app) {
  this.page = page;
  this.app = app;
  
  if (page && page.name === 'mypage') {
    try {
      // Retrieve saved values
      const savedSettings = getValue('myPageSettings', {
        selectedTab: 'default',
        filterValue: '',
        showDetails: true
      });
      
      // Apply saved values to page state
      page.state.selectedTab = savedSettings.selectedTab;
      page.state.filterValue = savedSettings.filterValue;
      page.state.showDetails = savedSettings.showDetails;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load saved settings', error);
    }
  }
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 5: Save values when they change`}</h3>
    <p>{`Implement handlers to save values when they change:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`/**
 * Save settings when they change
 */
saveSettings() {
  const settings = {
    selectedTab: this.page.state.selectedTab,
    filterValue: this.page.state.filterValue,
    showDetails: this.page.state.showDetails
  };
  
  saveValue('myPageSettings', settings);
}
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 6: Connect UI components to persistence logic`}</h3>

    <h2>{`Complete Example`}</h2>
    <p>{`Here’s a complete example showing how to persist filter settings across sessions:`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Page XML:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<page id="inventory">
  <state name="filterSettings" type="object" default-value="{category: 'all', showInStock: true, sortBy: 'name'}" />
  
  <page-header>
    <page-title>Inventory</page-title>
  </page-header>
  <container>
    <box>
      <dropdown id="categoryFilter" label="Category" value="{page.state.filterSettings.category}" on-change="handleCategoryChange">
        <dropdown-item value="all" label="All Categories" />
        <dropdown-item value="tools" label="Tools" />
        <dropdown-item value="parts" label="Parts" />
        <dropdown-item value="equipment" label="Equipment" />
      </dropdown>
      
      <checkbox id="inStockOnly" label="Show In-Stock Items Only" checked="{page.state.filterSettings.showInStock}" on-change="handleInStockChange" />
      
      <dropdown id="sortOrder" label="Sort By" value="{page.state.filterSettings.sortBy}" on-change="handleSortChange">
        <dropdown-item value="name" label="Name" />
        <dropdown-item value="price" label="Price" />
        <dropdown-item value="quantity" label="Quantity" />
      </dropdown>
    </box>
    <!-- Rest of your page content -->
  </container>
</page>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`import {Application} from '@maximo/maximo-js-api';

class AppCustomizations {
  /**
   * Initialize page references when the page is initialized
   * @param {Object} page - The page object
   * @param {Object} app - The application object
   */
  async pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.page = page;
    this.app = app;
    
    // Check if page exists and if it's the inventory page
    if (page && page.name === 'inventory') {
      try {
        // Retrieve saved filter settings
        const savedSettings = this.getStoredValue('inventoryFilterSettings', {
          category: 'all',
          showInStock: true,
          sortBy: 'name'
        });
        
        // Apply saved settings to page state
        page.state.filterSettings = savedSettings;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load filter settings', error);
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Handle category filter change
   * @param {string} value - The selected category
   */
  handleCategoryChange(value) {
    this.page.state.filterSettings.category = value;
    this.saveFilterSettings();
  }

  /**
   * Handle in-stock filter change
   * @param {boolean} checked - Whether to show only in-stock items
   */
  handleInStockChange(checked) {
    this.page.state.filterSettings.showInStock = checked;
    this.saveFilterSettings();
  }

  /**
   * Handle sort order change
   * @param {string} value - The selected sort field
   */
  handleSortChange(value) {
    this.page.state.filterSettings.sortBy = value;
    this.saveFilterSettings();
  }

  /**
   * Save all filter settings to localStorage
   */
  saveFilterSettings() {
    this.storeValue('inventoryFilterSettings', this.page.state.filterSettings);
  }

  /**
   * Store a value in localStorage
   * @param {string} key - Storage key
   * @param {any} value - Value to store
   */
  storeValue(key, value) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to save data to localStorage', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieve a value from localStorage
   * @param {string} key - Storage key
   * @param {any} defaultValue - Default value if not found
   * @returns {any} The stored value or default value
   */
  getStoredValue(key, defaultValue) {
    try {
      const storedValue = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return storedValue ? JSON.parse(storedValue) : defaultValue;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to retrieve data from localStorage', error);
      return defaultValue;
    }
  }
}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
    <h2>{`Best Practices and Considerations`}</h2>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Use Namespaced Keys`}</strong>{`: Prefix localStorage keys with your application name to avoid conflicts with other applications.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Handle Storage Errors`}</strong>{`: Always wrap localStorage operations in try/catch blocks to handle potential errors.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Provide Default Values`}</strong>{`: Always have fallback default values in case stored data is missing or corrupted.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Consider Storage Limits`}</strong>{`: localStorage is limited to about 5MB per domain, so be mindful of how much data you store.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Sensitive Data`}</strong>{`: Never store sensitive information in localStorage as it’s accessible to any JavaScript code running on the same domain.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`User-Specific Storage`}</strong>{`: For user-specific settings, consider prefixing keys with the user ID.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Versioning`}</strong>{`: Consider adding a version identifier to your stored data to handle schema changes.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Clear Functionality`}</strong>{`: Provide users with options to reset to defaults or clear their saved preferences.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Synchronization`}</strong>{`: For multi-device scenarios, consider syncing important preferences to the server.`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Privacy Modes`}</strong>{`: Be aware that localStorage may not be available or may be cleared in private browsing modes.`}</li>
    </ul>

    </MDXLayout>;
